_doc: Seam manifest (tana #454, recovered in deka #789). The declared cross-boundary contracts; `deka contract-check --manifest contracts/seams.json` checks every one and exits non-zero on drift. Producer = source of truth (rust:NAME or ts:PATH), consumer = the reading side. Paths are relative to the repo root.
_retired: The pre-migration manifest declared 15 seams whose consumers were PHPX fixtures (storefront, data_backend x5, harar_auth x4, platform.env_policy, linkhash.* x4). The PHPX extractor lived in `modules_php` on top of the `php_rs` typechecker and both crates were deleted by the DekaScript cutover; the `harar_client` and `linkhash` producers are likewise no longer in this repo. Those entries are retired, not stubbed. What is kept is every seam whose producer still exists here, re-expressed with a TypeScript consumer.
